description: Convert quiz photos (PNG to WebP) using image-utils Power and update QuestionViews.tsx to serve WebP-first with PNG fallback using <picture> elements
steps: 1. Use the image-utils Kiro Power to convert all 12 PNGs in public/quiz-photos/ (quiz-img-1.png through quiz-img-12.png) to WebP format at quality=85. Save as quiz-img-N.webp alongside the originals. Keep the .png files for browser fallback.
2. In src/components/quiz/QuestionViews.tsx, find the ImageChoiceQuestionView component. The current code renders:

3. Replace the plain tag in ImageChoiceQuestionView with a element. The picture element should: (a) detect if imageUrl ends with .png or .jpg and if so, offer a .webp source first (replace extension with .webp), then fall back to the original. (b) If the imageUrl is a base64/data URL or already .webp, just render the img directly without a separate source. The pattern should be: if (option.imageUrl && !option.imageUrl.startsWith('data:') && (option.imageUrl.endsWith('.png') || option.imageUrl.endsWith('.jpg') || option.imageUrl.endsWith('.jpeg'))) { const webpUrl = option.imageUrl.replace(/\.(png|jpe?g)$/i, '.webp'); return } else { return }
4. Also update the quiz-editor thumbnail in src/components/quiz/QuestionEditorPanel.tsx - the ImageOptionsSummary component renders . Wrap it in the same picture+source pattern.
5. Additionally, in the ImageChoiceEditor component in QuestionEditorPanel.tsx, the preview button renders . Wrap that in the same pattern too.
6. Verify the 12 .webp files exist in public/quiz-photos/
acceptance_criteria: public/quiz-photos/ contains quiz-img-1.webp through quiz-img-12.webp (12 WebP files)
public/quiz-photos/ still contains quiz-img-1.png through quiz-img-12.png (originals preserved)
ImageChoiceQuestionView in QuestionViews.tsx uses <picture> with <source type='image/webp'> for .png/.jpg URLs
The img tag inside the picture element has loading='lazy' and decoding='async'
verification: grep -n 'image/webp' src/components/quiz/QuestionViews.tsx should show a match
